title: 86% of Gym and Studio Owners Grew Membership This Year, Even as Costs and Competition Rise  - Health & Fitness Association

facts.fact: Wellhub's Fitness Business Growth Report 2026 found that 86% of gym and studio owners grew their membership base in the year surveyed.
facts.quote: 86% of gym and studio owners grew their membership base this year

facts.fact: Wellhub's Fitness Business Growth Report 2026 found that 56% of gym and studio owners improved their profit margin.
facts.quote: 56% improved their profit margin

facts.fact: The Wellhub Fitness Business Growth Report 2026 surveyed 662 gym and studio owners across 11 countries through an independent research firm.
facts.quote: surveyed 662 gym and studio owners across 11 countries

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 40% of owners said revenue is currently growing faster than costs.
facts.quote: Forty percent say revenue is currently growing faster than costs

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 23% of owners said revenue and costs are keeping pace.
facts.quote: 23% say the two are keeping pace

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 37% of owners said costs are growing faster than revenue.
facts.quote: 37% say costs are growing faster

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 95% of owners said competition has intensified over the past three years.
facts.quote: 95% of owners saying it has intensified over the past three years

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 40% of owners plan to open new locations in the next 12 months.
facts.quote: 40% plan to open new locations in the next 12 months

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 86% of owners said members have become more price-sensitive this year.
facts.quote: Eighty-six percent of owners say members have become more price-sensitive this year

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, the most common member request was more flexible or shorter contracts, cited by 66% of owners.
facts.quote: More flexible or shorter contracts are the most common request (66%)

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 65% of owners reported better digital or hybrid options as a common member request.
facts.quote: better digital or hybrid options (65%)

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 48% of owners reported recovery services as a common member request.
facts.quote: recovery services (48%)

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, lower prices ranked fourth among common member requests, cited by 46% of owners.
facts.quote: Lower prices rank only fourth, at 46%

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 82% of owners said their customer acquisition costs increased this year.
facts.quote: Eighty-two percent of owners say their customer acquisition costs have increased this year

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 6% of owners said member acquisition is supported by a dedicated marketing team or agency, and 87% spend up to half their working week personally on marketing and member acquisition.
facts.quote: With only 6% supported by a dedicated marketing team or agency, 87% spend up to half of their working week

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 65% of owners invested in new technology such as CRM platforms, booking systems, automation and AI tools in the past year.
facts.quote: Sixty-five percent of owners have invested in new technology

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 52% of owners said AI will be essential to competing for members over the next 12 months.
facts.quote: 52% say AI will be essential to competing for members over the next 12 months

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 85% of owners said at least a quarter of their facility sits unused during off-peak hours, while only 20% have a developed strategy to monetize that capacity.
facts.quote: Eighty-five percent of owners say at least a quarter of their facility sits unused during off-peak hours

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 76% of owners partnered with a corporate wellness platform say the revenue from that channel is new income rather than revenue shifted from existing members.
facts.quote: 76% say the revenue generated through the channel represents new income

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 59% of owners view corporate wellness partnerships more favorably than they did two years earlier.
facts.quote: 59% saying they view corporate wellness partnerships more favorably than they did two years ago

facts.fact: Per Health & Fitness Association benchmarking research cited on the page, 38% of high-profit clubs offer corporate programming versus 30% of operators overall globally, and 48% versus 35% in the US.
facts.quote: 38% versus 30% globally, and 48% versus 35% in the US

facts.fact: Wellhub's own data shows 90% of Wellhub members visiting partner gyms are reactivated or new to those facilities.
facts.quote: 90% of Wellhub members visiting partner gyms are reactivated or new to those facilities

facts.fact: In the Wellhub survey, 96% of Wellhub partners grew membership this year, compared with 80% of operators without a corporate wellness partnership.
facts.quote: Ninety-six percent of Wellhub partners grew membership this year, compared with 80%
